facts_raw.Foundshore Verdict: 低优先级 / 仅特定场景
facts_raw.Funding / Support: Mentorship, visibility, investor/biopharma access; competition funding up to US$300K on current apply/FAQ page
facts_raw.Equity / Economic Terms: No application fee; non-dilutive accelerator / competition
facts_raw.Official / Must-Have Requirements: Life science tools / molecular diagnostics startup；偏好未完成 Series B/重大 strategic partnership。可未成立公司申请，但 accelerator 开始前必须 incorporated。
facts_raw.Strong-to-Have: prototype + proof of concept；足够 runway 执行 milestone；senior founder/CEO 可全程参与。
facts_raw.On-site / Attendance: 4个月 virtual accelerator；cofounder/CEO/senior leader 必须参加 virtual program，并出席 October Showcase and Finals。

facts_raw.Foundshore Best Fit: Life-science tools、molecular diagnostics、research instruments、bioproduction、drug-discovery enabling tech；pre-seed–Series B。
facts_raw.Foundshore Not Fit: 传统 therapeutics company 本身；无 life-science tool/diagnostic enabling technology；已高度成熟且不需要产业导师。
facts_raw.Notes: Foundshore 评价：life-science tools 项目强推荐；不要和 therapeutics accelerator 混淆。

facts.Funding / Support: Mentorship, visibility, investor/biopharma access; competition funding up to US$300K on current apply/FAQ page
facts.Equity / Economic Terms: No application fee; non-dilutive accelerator / competition
facts.Official / Must-Have Requirements: Life-science tools or molecular diagnostics startups, preferably before Series B or a major strategic partnership. Incorporation is required before the accelerator begins, but not at application.
facts.Strong-to-Have: A prototype or proof of concept, sufficient runway for milestones and a senior founder or CEO available throughout the program.
facts.On-site / Attendance: Four-month virtual accelerator. A cofounder, CEO or senior leader must participate and attend the October Showcase and Finals.
facts.Visa / Relocation: Long-term relocation is not required; participants must meet entry requirements for the Showcase and Finals.
facts.Deadline / Next Intake: 2027 applications expected to reopen in October 2026; 2026 deadline was Dec 1, 2025
facts.Application Materials: Online application covering company, product, technology, stage, fundraising, proof of concept and runway.
facts.Foundshore Best Fit: Life-science tools、molecular diagnostics、research instruments、bioproduction、drug-discovery enabling tech；pre-seed–Series B。
facts.Foundshore Not Fit: Therapeutics companies without life-science tools or diagnostic enabling technology; mature companies with little need for industry mentors.
facts.Notes: Strong fit for life-science tools; distinct from a therapeutics accelerator.

ranking.amountBasis: Published initial cash; excludes conditional follow-on and non-cash benefits
